notes: Ground truth was transcribed by reading each image directly, NOT by running
the pipeline — using the system's own output as its answer key would make
`aliases` lists names that are clinically the same drug. A prediction that
returns the generic where the paper says the brand (Brufen -> Ibuprofen) is
scored as `name_acceptable` but not `name_exact`, so the two read apart.
`frequency_alt` / `duration_alt` list other defensible readings of an
ambiguous instruction, so the benchmark does not punish a correct answer
that the transcriber happened to phrase differently.
